In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], a '''terrorist attack''' occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].

==The attack==
Four explosions were detonated, damaging the [[Coruscant Central Court (building)|Coruscant Central Court building]], [[Coruscant Court of Appeals (building)|Coruscant Court of Appeals building]], and the [[Senate Overflow Offices]]. During the attack, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was injured when the explosion disrupted the [[Skylane/Legends|skylane]] he was flying with when the explosion occurred. The damage caused thousands of [[Death/Legends|deaths]]. In the immediate aftermath, [[Medical speeder|medwagons]] and [[Coruscant Rescue Ops/Legends|Coruscant Rescue Ops]] responded to put out the fires and rescue the victims. The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] (CSF) set up emergency checkpoints and [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]] secured the damaged areas. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] including [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], and [[Vokara Che]] also searched for Obi-Wan Kenobi who they found and took back to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Halls of Healing]].

==Aftermath==
In the aftermath, the skylanes around the Administrative Sector remained empty and the vast numbers of dead overwhelmed the CSF's ability to clear them and they remained there for days after. As the [[Coruscant Central Court]] and the [[Coruscant Court of Appeals]] did not have any facilities and many of its members killed, current cases were put on hold and new cases were backlogged. The [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judiciary]] struggled to find [[Judge/Legends|judges]] to hear cases as well as facilities in which to hold court. Also, many government officials had lost their offices and documents causing a rush on office equipment and supplies. The attacks were blamed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] took [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] on a tour of the damage which caused both to stand firmly behind Palpatine. This allowed him to act more aggressively in expanding security measures and heighten the ongoing [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Behind the scenes==
As noted in ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', which dates ''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]'' to 22 BBY, the attack on Coruscant contradicts the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]", which states that Coruscant had not been attacked in a thousand years.<ref name="ERC" />
